tiles.name: 빨강
tiles.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production mobile match-3 tile sprite, original game art. This is a replacement for the plain colored rounded rectangular blocks in Cloud Garden. Keep the established upright almost-square silhouette: width 92% of height, mostly straight sides, corner radius about 7%. One chunky softly sculpted GEM-JELLY block with an appealing raised, gently convex central face, a single clear chamfered bevel 6% wide, subtle rounded facets on the bevel, visible short lower side for substantial 3D depth. Make it clearly a beautiful tactile PUZZLE PIECE, not a plain flat UI rectangle or button. Vivid scarlet/ruby RED body around #F32027, luminous saturated red face, dark cherry-red lower bevel; no maroon or pink.. Color should feel BOLD, DENSE AND VIVID, with a bright saturated central face, strong darker colored lower bevel and rich colored midtones. Material: dense translucent-looking jelly gemstone, smooth polished surface, a few broad clean curved facet transitions; NO noisy texture, no tiny details. One small curved light reflection near upper-left corner and a thin soft colored edge highlight, plus a very subtle inner diagonal reflection across upper third. Constrain pale reflection to less than 3% of the visible area; never a broad glaring white stripe or white face. Keep most of the face deep rich RED. Small-size readability at 30 pixels, pronounced depth and color separation. No nested frame, inset panel, surrounding glow, neon edge outline or black border. Absolutely no fruit, crown, shield, bow, bell, letter, central symbol, badge, face or word. Just the sculpted block with dimensional facets. Front-on orthographic viewpoint, consistent upper-left light, no tilt. Single complete opaque-body tile on GENUINE TRANSPARENT background with transparent padding. No floor, external shadow, haze, particles, detached specks, labels, watermark, grid or extra object. Same shape, scale, lighting and sculpted structure across the six-color family.

cabinet.name: 씨앗 저장함
cabinet.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original production match-3 obstacle sprite. A chunky CLOSED SEED STORAGE CHEST, exactly two square board cells wide and one cell tall, overall 2:1 aspect ratio. Straight-on orthographic view, compact rectangular silhouette with slightly rounded corners. Two stout honey-gold wooden compartments side by side with a thick terracotta-orange structural rim, dark warm wooden lower side for tactile 3D depth, small brass corner protectors and one simple central latch. A large simple embossed GREEN SPROUT on each compartment makes it immediately recognizable as a seed chest, not a doorway or gate. Premium sculpted casual mobile puzzle game art, bright vivid colors, clear contrast, substantial volume, warm clean rounded bevels, soft upper-left colored light. Very simple bold large shapes readable when shown 70x35 screen pixels. The chest's opaque rectangular body must fill essentially the ENTIRE 2:1 object bounds. No legs, no flowers, trailing vines, floating decorations, gaps between the two halves, empty cutouts or transparent holes. No flat detached cream doors, no old teal body. Only tiny subtle controlled highlights, no white glare or surrounding glow. Isolate ONE complete closed chest with a truly transparent exterior, no floor or shadow outside the silhouette. No text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, frame or other object. Leave only consistent small transparent margins around the object; do not include a room, garden, UI or other tiles.
cabinet.normalization: 512x256 fitted body with zero additional icon padding. Render at 98% of its two-cell footprint. Counter at the lower-right of the full footprint.

notes: Separate generated source sprites, no AI-grid slicing. Remove detached generation residue, preserve main body and antialiasing. No changes to puzzle state, RNG, saved color IDs or obstacle mechanics.
